selectionRule: Original official English publication word count: all outermost eli-container blocks including recitals, provisions, annexes and notes, counted once; whole body fallback for older unstructured texts. Standalone corrigenda excluded. Unicode words/numbers counted. Script/style/navigation elements excluded. Counts require independent ranking audit.
selectionStatus: selected after independent identity, annex and cutoff audit
scope: All substantive changes introduced by the selected amending acts, and all later substantive amendments/corrigenda to the selected acts up to the snapshot. National checks address changed obligations and necessary exceptions, not every unchanged original provision. Repeals/recasts and transition/savings must be followed.
